meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin tone ke liye aisi sunscreen best hoti hain jo **transparent (invisible)** gel formula, silicone-based matte finish, ya **tinted** variants mein aati hain taaki bilkul bhi white cast na chhodein.

Aapke liye kuch best aur highly-rated options yeh hain:

### 1. Aqualogica Glow+ Dewy Sunscreen (SPF 50 PA++++ )

* **Skin Type:** All skin types (Especially dry to normal)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh water-gel based sunscreen hai jo skin mein bahut jaldi absorb ho jati hai. Isme Papaya aur Vitamin C hai jo glow deta hai aur bilkul white cast nahi chhodta.

### 2. Dot & Key Vitamin C + E Super Bright Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++

* **Skin Type:** Normal to combination skin
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh lightweight formula ke sath aati hai aur candy jaisi achhi khushboo hai. Skin par lagane ke baad bilkul invisible ho jati hai aur oily feel nahi karati.

### 3. minimalist Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++

* **Skin Type:** Sensitive, Oily & Combination skin
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh fragrance-free hai aur Photostable filters use karti hai. Yeh cream-based zaroor lagti hai shuru mein, lekin blend karne par bilkul transparent ho jati hai aur white cast nahi chhodti.

### 4. Fixderma Shadow SPF 50+ Gel

* **Skin Type:** Oily, Acne-prone & Sensitive skin
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh dermatologists dwara kafi recommend ki jati hai. Yeh non-greasy gel formula hai jo oily skin par ekdum dry finish deta hai aur white cast ka koi sawal hi nahi hai.

### 5. Deconstruct Gel Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++

* **Skin Type:** Oily & Acne-Prone skin
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh lightweight gel sunscreen hai jo UV rays ke sath-sath pollution se bhi protect karti hai. Blend karne par yeh bilkul transparent ho jati hai.

---

> **Tip:** Sunscreen hamesha ghar se nikalne se **15-20 minutes pehle** lagayein aur agar aap dhoop mein zyada der hain toh **har 2-3 ghante baad re-apply** zaroor karein.
